subject: The engine's doxorubicin CELL-MEMBRANE permeability, scored against the apparent cell permeability measured by Degerstedt 2024 (PMID 37824040, PMC10927899, CC BY 4.0).

disclosure_this_prereg_is_not_blind.note: Full disclosure: the engine values and the measured value were BOTH in hand when these criteria were frozen, and a back-of-envelope conversion of P_cell into a tissue sink rate had already been done by hand. What this pre-registration buys is therefore NOT blindness; it is that the DECISION RULES and the predicted directions/bands below cannot be moved after the numbers land. A reader who wants a blind test should treat TEST 1 and TEST 2 as bookkeeping and TEST 3 and TEST 4 as the registered predictions, since neither of those had been computed with the real shipped inputs at freeze time.

hard_constraints_acknowledged: No parameter is tuned to hit this anchor.
alpha is NOT changed; it is asserted live.
A failure is a recorded failure.
No absolute kill fraction is produced; no cross-compound ranking claim is made (WITHDRAWN 2026-08-21).

TEST_0_commensurability_gate.decided_by: reading the primary source BEFORE any computation
criteria_all_must_hold: both are defined as a flux per unit concentration difference across a CELL membrane
the length scale converting a first-order rate into a permeability is a cell volume/area ratio in both

evidence.paper_eq2: P_cell = (k_cell x V_cell)/(A_cell x 60), V/A = r/3
evidence.engine_entry_point: two_route.two_route_factor: biot = sigma_c/(cell_radius_um * P), i.e. 1/P is an interfacial resistance in series with the inclusion interior -> P is flux per unit concentration difference across the cell membrane, um/s

TEST_0_commensurability_gate.if_this_had_failed: every test below is VOID and the answer is reported as 'the comparison is not commensurable'

TEST_1_the_ratio.prior: the scouting pass reported 935x; this re-derives it

TEST_2_which_engine_term.status: value was in hand at freeze; registered for the record, not as a blind prediction
TEST_2_which_engine_term.registered_consequence_if_R1_gt_1_and_R2: the engine carries TWO shipped doxorubicin 'membrane permeability' numbers that STRADDLE the measurement, so no one-sided statement of the form 'the engine's permeability is X-fold off' is available, and the headline must be the INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY rather than a single gap

TEST_3_consequence_for_the_shipped_trans.procedure: re-call two_route.two_route_diffusivity for doxorubicin with membrane_permeability_um_s overridden to the measured 9.00e-4 um/s, every other input at its shipped value, and difference the resulting effective_D against the shipped compile. Also compute the P -> infinity ceiling.
TEST_3_consequence_for_the_shipped_trans.reason_stated_in_advance: the dimensionless membrane resistance sigma_c/(a*P) is 2.18e7 at the shipped P, so a ~934x rise in P leaves it near 2.3e4, still >> 1, and the inclusion phase stays effectively impermeable
TEST_3_consequence_for_the_shipped_trans.registered_consequence_of_a_pass: the 10^3 permeability gap has NO consequence for any shipped doxorubicin transport number, which forbids calling it 'the most consequential number' on D_eff grounds and forces the alpha argument to stand entirely on its own

TEST_4_the_alpha_test.why: calibration.py attributes a ~300x sink to 'rapid cellular uptake plus high-capacity intracellular / DNA binding' and explicitly declines to use permeability as the proxy. The scouting pass claims the measurement REFRAMES alpha as a patch for a measurably wrong permeability. This test decides that.
TEST_4_the_alpha_test.construction: membrane-limited uptake cannot remove extracellular solute faster than P * (S/V). At the ENGINE's own geometry, S/V_tissue = 3*phi/a. Report BOTH conventions: k_ceiling_tissue = P * 3*phi/a and k_ceiling_interstitial = k_ceiling_tissue/(1-phi). The interstitial one is the PERMISSIVE end and the verdict uses it.
TEST_4_the_alpha_test.registered_reading_of_outcome_B: Under B, alpha asserts a perivascular sink ABOVE the ceiling that a MEASURED doxorubicin cell permeability can sustain. A binding CAPACITY cannot rescue that: capacity sets how long a flux can be absorbed, permeability sets the flux. So B is NOT 'the same hole counted twice'. It is a NEW, independent, measured UPPER BOUND that alpha violates, and it is a different finding from the one the scouting pass asserted.
TEST_4_the_alpha_test.sensitivity_arm: repeat the ceiling with P_MDCK_MICROVESSEL = 32e-4 um/s, the highest measured DOX cell permeability Degerstedt cite (their ref 65, NOT verified at its own source), to establish whether the verdict's DIRECTION survives the top of the measured range

TEST_5_the_transvascular_term.status: definitional correction, established by reading code, not a test
TEST_5_the_transvascular_term.finding_at_freeze: tmesim/treatment/transvascular.py states in its own docstring that the repository has NEITHER factor of PS = P*(S/V): the shipped entry term is PS = vascular_density * bbb_penetrance * PS_SCALE_S_INV with PS_SCALE_S_INV = 1 s^-1 undocumented, and no measured vessel radius exists. There is therefore NO transvascular wall permeability in the engine to score.
TEST_5_the_transvascular_term.and: Degerstedt's P_cell is a CELL permeability, not a vessel-wall permeability, so it would be the wrong anchor for one even if the term existed. The task's 'transvascular permeability term' framing is corrected to 'cell-membrane permeability term'.

what_this_cannot_establish_whatever_the_: HepG2 hepatoma in a collagen/fibrinogen gel is not GBM in brain; nothing here transfers a doxorubicin number to another compound or another tissue.

P_cell is APPARENT: it lumps active transport, binding and partition, and doxorubicin is a P-gp substrate and a DNA intercalator. The engine's P_mem is a PASSIVE permeability. These are not strictly the same object.

The authors state the fluorescence self-quenches above ~25 uM and that they are 'more likely to underestimate rather than overestimate' P_cell, so the measurement is a LOWER bound and every ceiling derived from it is a lower bound on a ceiling.
No absolute output of the simulator is validated or invalidated by this; the subject is one shipped parameter and one derived rate.
